parameters.query:
-- W34 job 1 (I-35l): WhatsApp quiz threads past expires_at (72 h life, smc_10). A row with no expires_at is purged
-- once updated_at is older than W34_WA_THREAD_MAX_HOURS. One retention_log row per thread; row_id carries only a
-- 12-character hash prefix (no full identifier kept for a person who never became a lead).
-- $1 wa_expired_before, $2 wa_stale_before, $3 dry_run
with due as (
  select wx.brand_id, wx.mobile_hash
  from public.wa_threads wx
  where (nullif($1, '') is not null and wx.expires_at is not null and wx.expires_at < nullif($1, '')::timestamptz)
     or (nullif($2, '') is not null and wx.expires_at is null and wx.updated_at < nullif($2, '')::timestamptz)
), del as (
  delete from public.wa_threads wt
  using due
  where not $3::boolean and wt.brand_id = due.brand_id and wt.mobile_hash = due.mobile_hash
  returning wt.brand_id, wt.mobile_hash
), lg as (
  insert into public.retention_log (table_name, row_id, action, policy)
  select 'public.wa_threads', del.brand_id::text || ':' || left(del.mobile_hash, 12), 'delete', 'wa_thread_expired' from del
  returning 1
)
select 'wa_threads' as job, (select count(*) from due)::int as due, (select count(*) from lg)::int as done;

-- W34 job 2: form entries that did not fit (age/budget band) are deleted W34_NONFIT_RETENTION_HOURS after
-- created_at (privacy notice: "deleted within 24 hours"). Only rows never qualified AND never handed to a broker.
-- smc_erase_lead('delete') removes the row (cascades activities); suppression rows survive (lead_id SET NULL).
-- $1 nonfit_before, $2 test_mode, $3 batch, $4 dry_run, $5 policy
with due as (
  select l.id
  from public.leads l
  where nullif($1, '') is not null
    and l.brand_id is not null
    and coalesce(l.is_synthetic, false) = $2::boolean
    and l.qualified_at is null
    and l.disqualified_reason is not null
    and l.broker_id is null
    and l.created_at <= nullif($1, '')::timestamptz
    and not exists (select 1 from public.dsr_requests dq where dq.lead_id = l.id and dq.status not in ('completed', 'rejected'))
  order by l.created_at
  limit $3::int
), done as (
  select d.id, public.smc_erase_lead(d.id, 'delete', $5) from due d where not $4::boolean
)
select 'nonfit' as job, (select count(*) from due)::int as due, (select count(*) from done)::int as done, '[]'::jsonb as media_urls;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Set retention context').first().json.cutoffs.nonfit_before, $('Set retention context').first().json.test_mode, $('Set retention context').first().json.batch, $('Set retention context').first().json.dry_run, $('Set retention context').first().json.policy.nonfit] }}

parameters.query:
-- W34 job 3: details and messages W34_LEAD_RETENTION_MONTHS after last contact -> smc_erase_lead('pseudonymise').
-- Names, numbers, email, IP/UA, message content, transcripts, join links go; the consent record (wording, version,
-- timestamps, URL, source, disclosure message id) stays as evidence until job 5. Skips leads with an open data-subject
-- request (records under request must not be destroyed) and leads with a future booking.
-- Media references are read in the same snapshot, before erasure, for the media-erase step.
-- $1 lead_before, $2 test_mode, $3 batch, $4 dry_run, $5 policy
with due as (
  select l.id
  from public.leads l
  where nullif($1, '') is not null
    and l.brand_id is not null
    and coalesce(l.is_synthetic, false) = $2::boolean
    and coalesce(l.phone, '') not like 'erased:%'
    and greatest(coalesce(l.last_contact_at, l.created_at), coalesce(l.opted_out_at, l.created_at), l.created_at) <= nullif($1, '')::timestamptz
    and not exists (select 1 from public.dsr_requests dq where dq.lead_id = l.id and dq.status not in ('completed', 'rejected'))
    and not exists (select 1 from public.appointments ap where ap.client_id = l.id and ap.status in ('booked', 'confirmed') and coalesce(ap.ends_at, ap.appointment_date::timestamptz) > now())
  order by l.created_at
  limit $3::int
), media as (
  select o.voice_note_url as url from public.outcomes o where o.lead_id in (select id from due) and o.voice_note_url is not null
  union all
  select c.call_recording_url from public.communications c where c.lead_id in (select id from due) and c.call_recording_url is not null
), done as (
  select d.id, public.smc_erase_lead(d.id, 'pseudonymise', $5) from due d where not $4::boolean
)
select 'lead_retention' as job, (select count(*) from due)::int as due, (select count(*) from done)::int as done,
       case when $4::boolean then '[]'::jsonb else (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(media.url), '[]'::jsonb) from media) end as media_urls;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Set retention context').first().json.cutoffs.lead_before, $('Set retention context').first().json.test_mode, $('Set retention context').first().json.batch, $('Set retention context').first().json.dry_run, $('Set retention context').first().json.policy.lead] }}

parameters.query:
-- W34 job 3b: smc_erase_lead('pseudonymise') does not touch the legacy leads.name / company / role columns
-- (finding for platform-architect: fold into the function). Until then this clears them on every pseudonymised row.
-- $1 test_mode, $2 dry_run
update public.leads lr
set name = 'erased', company = null, role = null
where not $2::boolean
  and lr.brand_id is not null
  and coalesce(lr.is_synthetic, false) = $1::boolean
  and coalesce(lr.phone, '') like 'erased:%'
  and (lr.name is distinct from 'erased' or lr.company is not null or lr.role is not null)
returning lr.id;

nodes.name: Delete consent records after consent retention

parameters.query:
-- W34 job 4: the consent record and opt-out are evidence for W34_CONSENT_RETENTION_YEARS (privacy notice: 5 years).
-- Anchor = the latest of consent, opt-out and last contact. Only already-pseudonymised rows qualify (the consent period
-- can never end before the lead period: enforced in Set retention context). smc_erase_lead('delete') removes the row.
-- NEVER touched: public.suppression (hash + source survive; lead_id goes NULL), public.audit_log, public.retention_log.
-- $1 consent_before, $2 test_mode, $3 batch, $4 dry_run, $5 policy
with due as (
  select l.id
  from public.leads l
  where nullif($1, '') is not null
    and l.brand_id is not null
    and coalesce(l.is_synthetic, false) = $2::boolean
    and coalesce(l.phone, '') like 'erased:%'
    and greatest(coalesce(l.consent_at, l.created_at), coalesce(l.opted_out_at, l.created_at), coalesce(l.last_contact_at, l.created_at)) <= nullif($1, '')::timestamptz
    and not exists (select 1 from public.dsr_requests dq where dq.lead_id = l.id and dq.status not in ('completed', 'rejected'))
  order by l.created_at
  limit $3::int
), done as (
  select d.id, public.smc_erase_lead(d.id, 'delete', $5) from due d where not $4::boolean
)
select 'consent_retention' as job, (select count(*) from due)::int as due, (select count(*) from done)::int as done, '[]'::jsonb as media_urls;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Set retention context').first().json.cutoffs.consent_before, $('Set retention context').first().json.test_mode, $('Set retention context').first().json.batch, $('Set retention context').first().json.dry_run, $('Set retention context').first().json.policy.consent] }}

parameters.query:
-- W34 job 5: closed data-subject requests keep their dates, kind and outcome (evidence of the 30-day answer) but lose
-- the requester's name and contact after W34_DSR_RECORD_YEARS. Real records only: skipped in test mode.
-- $1 dsr_record_before, $2 policy, $3 test_mode, $4 dry_run
with u as (
  update public.dsr_requests dm
  set requester = null, requester_contact = null, updated_at = now()
  where nullif($1, '') is not null
    and not $3::boolean and not $4::boolean
    and dm.status in ('completed', 'rejected')
    and coalesce(dm.completed_at, dm.updated_at) <= nullif($1, '')::timestamptz
    and (dm.requester is not null or dm.requester_contact is not null)
  returning dm.id
), lg as (
  insert into public.retention_log (table_name, row_id, action, policy, dsr_id)
  select 'public.dsr_requests', u.id::text, 'pseudonymise', $2, u.id from u
  returning 1
)
select 'dsr_records' as job, (select count(*) from lg)::int as done;

parameters.query:
-- Register P8 (retention purge nightly). green when every job ran and no setting was refused; red otherwise.
update public.obligations
set last_done_at = now(), status = case when $1::boolean then 'red' else 'green' end, note = $2, updated_at = now()
where code = 'P8' and not $3::boolean
returning code, status;

nodes.name: DSR intake (manual webhook)
nodes.notes: Console / IO posts {kind, channel, requester, contact, lead_id?, request_ref?, note?}. Portal form, WhatsApp "delete my details" and post are entered here.

parameters.query:
-- W34 intake: one dsr_requests row (the 30-day clock: due_at) + one ops.notifications ticket kind 'dsar' for the
-- Information Officer. Idempotent on dedupe_key (same email / same request_ref never opens two tickets).
-- The ticket payload carries no name or contact: dsr id, kind, due date and how many leads the hash matched.
-- Nothing is exported or erased here: identity is verified by the IO first (verified_at), then the action webhook runs.
-- $1 normalised request (json), $2 IO recipient
with v as (
  select * from jsonb_to_record($1::jsonb) as v(kind text, channel text, requester text, requester_contact text, subject_hash text,
    mobile_hash text, lead_id uuid, received_at timestamptz, due_at timestamptz, dedupe_key text, source_ref text)
), dup as (
  select 1 as hit from ops.notifications nd, v where nd.dedupe_key = v.dedupe_key limit 1
), r as (
  insert into public.dsr_requests (kind, channel, requester, requester_contact, subject_hash, mobile_hash, lead_id, received_at, due_at, status, note)
  select v.kind, v.channel, v.requester, v.requester_contact, v.subject_hash, v.mobile_hash, v.lead_id, v.received_at, v.due_at, 'received', v.source_ref
  from v where not exists (select 1 from dup)
  returning id, kind, due_at, subject_hash, mobile_hash, lead_id
), m as (
  select count(*)::int as n
  from public.leads lm, r
  where lm.brand_id is not null
    and (lm.id = r.lead_id
      or (r.mobile_hash is not null and encode(extensions.digest(case when regexp_replace(lm.phone, '\D', '', 'g') like '00%' then substr(regexp_replace(lm.phone, '\D', '', 'g'), 3) when regexp_replace(lm.phone, '\D', '', 'g') like '0%' then '27' || substr(regexp_replace(lm.phone, '\D', '', 'g'), 2) else regexp_replace(lm.phone, '\D', '', 'g') end, 'sha256'), 'hex') = r.mobile_hash)
      or (r.subject_hash is not null and public.smc_hash_contact(lm.email) = r.subject_hash))
), t as (
  insert into ops.notifications (kind, recipient, channel, ref_table, ref_id, dedupe_key, status, source, what, severity, payload)
  select 'dsar', $2, 'whatsapp', 'public.dsr_requests', r.id::text, (select dedupe_key from v), 'queued', 'W34',
         'Data-subject request (' || r.kind || ') received. Verify identity, then answer by ' || to_char(r.due_at at time zone 'Africa/Johannesburg', 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
         'amber', jsonb_build_object('dsr_id', r.id, 'kind', r.kind, 'due_at', r.due_at, 'matched_leads', (select n from m))
  from r
  returning id
)
select (select id from r) as dsr_id, (select kind from r) as kind, (select due_at from r) as due_at,
       (select n from m) as matched_leads, (select count(*) from t)::int as tickets, exists (select 1 from dup) as duplicate;

nodes.name: Alert Information Officer (W22)
nodes.notes: W22 input: { kind: 'dsar_received', to: [IO], severity: 'amber', deep_link: console /compliance/dsr/<id> }

parameters.query:
-- Open data-subject requests and their clock. No name or contact selected.
select dr.id, dr.kind, dr.status, dr.received_at, dr.verified_at, dr.due_at
from public.dsr_requests dr
where dr.status not in ('completed', 'rejected')
order by dr.due_at;

-- One 'dsar' ticket per request per day (dedupe_key). $1 tickets json, $2 IO recipient
with x as (
  select * from jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) as x(dsr_id uuid, severity text, days_left int, dedupe_key text, what text)
), ins as (
  insert into ops.notifications (kind, recipient, channel, ref_table, ref_id, dedupe_key, status, source, what, severity, always_send, payload)
  select 'dsar', $2, 'whatsapp', 'public.dsr_requests', x.dsr_id::text, x.dedupe_key, 'queued', 'W34', x.what, x.severity, (x.severity = 'red'),
         jsonb_build_object('dsr_id', x.dsr_id, 'days_left', x.days_left)
  from x
  where not exists (select 1 from ops.notifications nn where nn.dedupe_key = x.dedupe_key)
  returning 1
)
select count(*)::int as queued from ins;

nodes.name: Alert DSR clock (W22)
nodes.notes: Missed 30-day SLA = Red (both phones + email, MASTER-PROMPT W34 row). Amber = IO only.

nodes.name: DSR action (manual webhook)
nodes.notes: Console posts {dsr_id, action: export|erase, confirm_dsr_id}. The SQL itself refuses unless dsr_requests.verified_at is set and the request is open.

parameters.query:
-- W34 DSR export (access request, POPIA s23). Reviewed statement: physical column names only. Runs only for a verified,
-- open request. Covers leads, communications, appointments, outcomes, lead_activities and the suppression entry.
-- Not exported: other people's data, internal scores of other leads, audit_log internals.
-- $1 dsr_id
with q as (
  select dq.id as dsr_id, dq.lead_id, dq.mobile_hash, dq.subject_hash
  from public.dsr_requests dq
  where dq.id = $1::uuid and dq.verified_at is not null and dq.status not in ('completed', 'rejected')
), subj as (
  select ls.id from public.leads ls, q where ls.brand_id is not null
    and (ls.id = q.lead_id
      or (q.mobile_hash is not null and encode(extensions.digest(case when regexp_replace(ls.phone, '\D', '', 'g') like '00%' then substr(regexp_replace(ls.phone, '\D', '', 'g'), 3) when regexp_replace(ls.phone, '\D', '', 'g') like '0%' then '27' || substr(regexp_replace(ls.phone, '\D', '', 'g'), 2) else regexp_replace(ls.phone, '\D', '', 'g') end, 'sha256'), 'hex') = q.mobile_hash)
      or (q.subject_hash is not null and public.smc_hash_contact(ls.email) = q.subject_hash))
)
select (select dsr_id from q) as dsr_id, (select count(*) from subj)::int as leads_found,
  jsonb_build_object(
    'generated_at', now(),
    'leads', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'id', le.id, 'first_name', le.first_name, 'last_name', le.last_name, 'phone', le.phone, 'email', le.email,
        'call_number', le.call_number, 'alt_number', le.alt_number, 'language', le.language, 'best_time', le.best_time,
        'age_band', le.age_band, 'budget_band', le.budget_band, 'bond', le.bond, 'dependants', le.dependants, 'work_cover', le.work_cover,
        'method_pref', le.method_pref, 'stage', le.stage, 'created_at', le.created_at, 'last_contact_at', le.last_contact_at,
        'origin', le.origin, 'source', le.source, 'page_url', le.page_url, 'utm_campaign', le.utm_campaign,
        'client_ip', le.client_ip, 'client_user_agent', le.client_user_agent,
        'consent_text', le.consent_text, 'consent_text_version', le.consent_text_version, 'consent_mode', le.consent_mode,
        'consent_at', le.consent_at, 'consent_ads_at', le.consent_ads_at, 'consent_page_url', le.consent_page_url, 'consent_source', le.consent_source,
        'disclosure_msg_id', le.disclosure_msg_id, 'disclosure_delivered_at', le.disclosure_delivered_at,
        'qualified_at', le.qualified_at, 'disqualified_reason', le.disqualified_reason, 'opted_out_at', le.opted_out_at,
        'broker_id', le.broker_id, 'retention_delete_after', le.retention_delete_after)), '[]'::jsonb)
      from public.leads le where le.id in (select id from subj)),
    'messages', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'channel', cm.channel, 'direction', cm.direction, 'created_at', cm.created_at, 'content', cm.content, 'subject', cm.subject,
        'template_name', cm.template_name, 'status', cm.status, 'delivered_at', cm.delivered_at, 'read_at', cm.read_at) order by cm.created_at), '[]'::jsonb)
      from public.communications cm where cm.lead_id in (select id from subj)),
    'bookings', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'appointment_date', ap.appointment_date, 'ends_at', ap.ends_at, 'method', ap.method, 'status', ap.status,
        'booked_at', ap.booked_at, 'cancelled_at', ap.cancelled_at, 'call_number', ap.call_number)), '[]'::jsonb)
      from public.appointments ap where ap.client_id in (select id from subj)),
    'outcomes', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'outcome', oc.outcome, 'disposition_code', oc.disposition_code, 'quality_score', oc.quality_score, 'summary', oc.summary,
        'marked_at', oc.marked_at)), '[]'::jsonb)
      from public.outcomes oc where oc.lead_id in (select id from subj)),
    'activity', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('activity_type', la.activity_type, 'occurred_at', la.occurred_at, 'workflow', la.workflow) order by la.occurred_at), '[]'::jsonb)
      from public.lead_activities la where la.lead_id in (select id from subj)),
    'opt_outs', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('source', sp.source, 'added_at', sp.added_at)), '[]'::jsonb)
      from public.suppression sp where sp.lead_id in (select id from subj))
  ) as export;

-- The IO sends the file over a secure channel and closes the request in the console (completed_at).
update public.dsr_requests dx
set export_url = $2, status = 'in_progress', updated_at = now()
where dx.id = $1::uuid and dx.verified_at is not null and dx.status not in ('completed', 'rejected')
returning dx.id, dx.due_at;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Check DSR action').first().json.dsr_id, $('Check DSR action').first().json.export_dir + '/dsr-' + $('Check DSR action').first().json.dsr_id + '.json'] }}

parameters.query:
-- W34 DSR erase step 1 (POPIA s24): suppress FIRST, hash only, Lead Velocity-wide (brand_id NULL), so nothing can
-- message the person while or after the erase runs. Insert-only; an existing hash is left exactly as it is.
-- Also captures what the broker notice needs (privacy notice: "we also tell the adviser") before names are erased.
-- $1 dsr_id
with q as (
  select dq.id as dsr_id, dq.lead_id, dq.mobile_hash, dq.subject_hash
  from public.dsr_requests dq
  where dq.id = $1::uuid and dq.kind = 'erase' and dq.verified_at is not null and dq.status not in ('completed', 'rejected')
), subj as (
  select ls.id, ls.broker_id, ls.first_name, encode(extensions.digest(case when regexp_replace(ls.phone, '\D', '', 'g') like '00%' then substr(regexp_replace(ls.phone, '\D', '', 'g'), 3) when regexp_replace(ls.phone, '\D', '', 'g') like '0%' then '27' || substr(regexp_replace(ls.phone, '\D', '', 'g'), 2) else regexp_replace(ls.phone, '\D', '', 'g') end, 'sha256'), 'hex') as mh
  from public.leads ls, q
  where coalesce(ls.phone, '') not like 'erased:%' and ls.brand_id is not null
    and (ls.id = q.lead_id
      or (q.mobile_hash is not null and encode(extensions.digest(case when regexp_replace(ls.phone, '\D', '', 'g') like '00%' then substr(regexp_replace(ls.phone, '\D', '', 'g'), 3) when regexp_replace(ls.phone, '\D', '', 'g') like '0%' then '27' || substr(regexp_replace(ls.phone, '\D', '', 'g'), 2) else regexp_replace(ls.phone, '\D', '', 'g') end, 'sha256'), 'hex') = q.mobile_hash)
      or (q.subject_hash is not null and public.smc_hash_contact(ls.email) = q.subject_hash))
), hs as (
  select s.mh, s.id from subj s where s.mh is not null
  union
  select q.mobile_hash, q.lead_id from q where q.mobile_hash is not null
), ins as (
  insert into public.suppression (mobile_hash, source, brand_id, lead_id, note)
  select distinct on (hs.mh) hs.mh, 'dsr_erase', null, hs.id, 'W34 ' || (select dsr_id from q) from hs
  on conflict (mobile_hash, source) do nothing
  returning 1
)
select (select dsr_id from q) as dsr_id, (select count(*) from subj)::int as leads_found, (select count(*) from ins)::int as suppressed,
       (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(s.id), '[]'::jsonb) from subj s) as lead_ids,
       (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('broker_id', s.broker_id, 'lead_id', s.id, 'first_name', s.first_name)), '[]'::jsonb) from subj s where s.broker_id is not null) as broker_notices;

-- W34 DSR erase step 2: smc_erase_lead per matched lead (audited; retention_log row carries dsr_id).
-- Default action 'pseudonymise' keeps the consent record as evidence (W34_DSR_ERASE_ACTION=delete removes the row:
-- practitioner question). Never touches public.suppression, public.audit_log or public.retention_log.
-- $1 dsr_id, $2 lead ids (json array), $3 erase action
with q as (
  select dq.id as dsr_id
  from public.dsr_requests dq
  where dq.id = $1::uuid and dq.kind = 'erase' and dq.verified_at is not null and dq.status not in ('completed', 'rejected')
), ids as (
  select (jsonb_array_elements_text($2::jsonb))::uuid as id
), media as (
  select o.voice_note_url as url from public.outcomes o where o.lead_id in (select id from ids) and o.voice_note_url is not null
  union all
  select c.call_recording_url from public.communications c where c.lead_id in (select id from ids) and c.call_recording_url is not null
), done as (
  select i.id, public.smc_erase_lead(i.id, $3, 'dsr_erase', (select dsr_id from q)) from ids i where exists (select 1 from q)
)
select (select dsr_id from q) as dsr_id, (select count(*) from done)::int as erased,
       (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(media.url), '[]'::jsonb) from media) as media_urls;

nodes.name: Erase subject media (storage)
nodes.notes: Same placeholder as the nightly media erase (NH-CQ-W34-6). An empty urls[] is a no-op.

parameters.query:
-- Close the request. in_time = answered inside the 30-day clock (register P7 evidence).
-- $1 dsr_id, $2 erased count, $3 erase action
update public.dsr_requests dc
set status = 'completed', completed_at = now(), updated_at = now(),
    note = coalesce(dc.note, '') || ' | W34 ' || $3 || ' ' || $2 || ' lead(s)'
where dc.id = $1::uuid and dc.kind = 'erase' and dc.verified_at is not null and dc.status not in ('completed', 'rejected')
returning dc.id, dc.completed_at, dc.due_at, (dc.completed_at <= dc.due_at) as in_time;

parameters.query:
-- What was purged last month (retention_log, append-only) + the DSR clock record. Counts only.
-- $1 month 'YYYY-MM' (SAST)
with b as (
  select (($1 || '-01')::date::timestamp at time zone 'Africa/Johannesburg') as start_at,
         ((($1 || '-01')::date + interval '1 month')::timestamp at time zone 'Africa/Johannesburg') as end_at
)
select
  (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('policy', x.policy, 'table_name', x.table_name, 'action', x.action, 'rows', x.n) order by x.table_name, x.policy), '[]'::jsonb)
     from (select rl.policy, rl.table_name, rl.action, count(*)::int as n from public.retention_log rl, b
           where rl.at >= b.start_at and rl.at < b.end_at group by rl.policy, rl.table_name, rl.action) x) as purged,
  (select count(*) from public.dsr_requests d1, b where d1.received_at >= b.start_at and d1.received_at < b.end_at)::int as dsr_received,
  (select count(*) from public.dsr_requests d2, b where d2.completed_at >= b.start_at and d2.completed_at < b.end_at)::int as dsr_completed,
  (select count(*) from public.dsr_requests d3, b where d3.completed_at >= b.start_at and d3.completed_at < b.end_at and d3.completed_at > d3.due_at)::int as dsr_completed_late,
  (select count(*) from public.dsr_requests d4 where d4.status not in ('completed', 'rejected') and d4.due_at < now())::int as dsr_overdue_now,
  (select count(*) from public.suppression s1, b where s1.added_at >= b.start_at and s1.added_at < b.end_at and s1.source = 'dsr_erase')::int as dsr_suppressed;

-- Monthly evidence link on P7 (DSR 30 days) and P8 (retention). Status is set nightly (P8) / by the IO (P7).
update public.obligations
set evidence_url = $1, updated_at = now()
where code in ('P7', 'P8') and not $2::boolean
returning code;
